The information contained within this announcement is deemed by the Company to constitute inside information as stipulated under the UK version of the EU Market Abuse Regulation (2014/596) which is part of UK law by virtue of the European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018, as amended and supplemented from time to time.
18 September 2026
Huddled Group plc
("Huddled", the "Company" or the "Group")
Trading Update
Huddled Group PLC (AIM:HUD), the circular economy e-commerce group behind Peeko, the UK’s online surplus superstore, today announces a significant strategic development with the launch of its live commerce operation. This initiative represents an evolution of the Company’s value
‑
driven ecommerce model and introduces live, presenter
‑
led shopping formats integrated with automated fulfilment and next
‑
day delivery.
Shareholders are invited to watch the c.20-minute recorded business update, in which Founder and Executive Chairman Martin Higginson calls the move “one of the most exciting developments in Huddled’s evolution”. With weekly revenue growing to circa £100k, the board is encouraged by the early progress and looks forward to the potential rapid growth live commerce could deliver.
The video will be available on the Company’s YouTube channel, @HuddledGroup and is being promoted on the company website, Huddled.com and across its social media platforms, X, Facebook, and LinkedIn.
In the video address, Martin explains:
Background and Strategic Rationale
Huddled’s core proposition has focused on acquiring surplus stock and delivering value to customers. With price
‑
led messaging increasingly prevalent across the retail sector, the Company identified live commerce as a differentiated channel combining entertainment, social interaction, and real
‑
time auctions - a format already gaining traction at pace in Asia and the United States.
Technology Integration and Operational Capability
The Company has developed proprietary technology connecting live commerce platforms directly to its automated fulfilment operation. This integration is designed to support real
‑
time order processing at scale and provide next
‑
day delivery for qualifying orders placed by 10pm.
Current live commerce capability includes:
Real
‑
time auctions across Whatnot and TikTok
Presenter
‑
led broadcasts across multiple product categories
Automated fulfilment linked directly to live orders
Next
‑
day delivery on qualifying orders
Early Performance Indicators
Since soft
‑
launching live channels, Huddled has recorded encouraging early metrics across categories including gadgets, beauty and groceries.
Initial performance includes:
Weekly sales of approximately £100,000
Strong repeat visits and purchasing patterns
High viewer dwell time and active chat participation
Growing communities around presenters and product drops
The Company notes that “Customers don’t just browse, they stay, chat, bid and return.”
Planned Expansion
Huddled intends to expand its live commerce footprint over the coming weeks, including:
Additional product categories and extended broadcast hours
Launching on eBay Live
Beta testing of its proprietary live
‑
auction platform
Strategic Positioning
The Company will continue to use surplus inventory to deliver value, now supported by entertainment
‑
led formats and integrated technology. This development aims to enhance customer engagement and broaden Huddled’s ecommerce capabilities.
Further Updates
Huddled will provide additional information on its live commerce strategy and platform development alongside its interim results later this month.
Martin Higginson, Executive Chairman of Huddled Group plc said:
“Huddled’s move into live commerce marks an exciting evolution of our strategy: using surplus inventory to deliver exceptional value, while adding entertainment, community, technology, and convenience to the customer experience.
“Early testing across Whatnot and TikTok has been highly encouraging, with weekly sales already reaching approximately £100,000 and strong signs of repeat engagement. While there is still much to learn and refine, we believe Huddled is well positioned to capitalise on this emerging opportunity by making online shopping more engaging, more rewarding, and above all, fun.”

latest.title: Live Commerce Strategy Accelerated with TikTok JV
latest.content:
Today 07:00
RNS Number : 7676R
Huddled Group PLC
24 August 2026
HUDDLED GROUP PLC
("Huddled" or the "Company")
Huddled Accelerates Live Commerce Strategy with TikTok Joint Venture
Huddled Group plc (AIM: HUD), the circular economy e-commerce group, is pleased to announce further expansion of its Live Commerce strategy. Hot on the heels of its recently announced Whatnot partnership with AEWW, the Company has entered into a joint venture with Cipher, one of the UK's leading TikTok agencies, to operate Peeko Live Commerce channels across TikTok Live and TikTok Auctions.
Cipher will be responsible for the presenters and studios, while Huddled contributes stock and fulfilment, with profits split 50:50.
The partnership will see the Peeko-Beauty stream launch on the TikTok platform later this week, initially as a beta trial to prove delivery timelines, which, once satisfied, will be scaled to several hours per day, and followed by launches in Tech, and Treats, over the following weeks. Further categories will follow in the coming months as the model is honed and scaled.
Central to the deal is Huddled's newly-developed proprietary software, which connects third-party live-selling partners directly into its centralised stock and automated fulfilment infrastructure, including next-day delivery on orders placed up to 10pm. The software allows Huddled to add new Live Commerce partners and platforms with minimal incremental overhead or operational burden, underpinning the Company's route to profitability.
This is the second auction platform deal in as many weeks, underpinning the board's belief that its proprietary Live Commerce technology is a repeatable and scalable growth engine.
Martin Higginson, Executive Chairman of Huddled Group plc
,
commented:
"Deals like this let us scale rapidly without taking on the cost or complexity of presenters, studios, or production. Cipher is one of the leading TikTok agencies and understands exactly how to maximise revenue on the platform. Combining Peeko's brand with a range of TikTok-branded live auction streams, experienced presenters, and swift next-day delivery, we believe Peeko can quickly become the leading live auction destination across multiple Live Commerce platforms - and each new platform we add strengthens the case for our technology as a scalable, repeatable growth model."
Jesper Anker and Hadleigh Banfield, Joint Managing Directors of Cipher Limited, added:
"We're excited to be partnering with Peeko on our journey to become the #1 TikTok Shop Agency in the UK. This agreement allows us to build a strong revenue stream through professional auction livestreams hosted by our skilled full time presenters and producers. Peeko's next day delivery and vast product range is particular disruptive to the TikTok Shop Auction Industry"

latest.title: Launch of Proprietary Live Commerce Software & JV
latest.content:
Today 07:00
RNS Number : 0303R
Huddled Group PLC
18 August 2026
HUDDLED GROUP PLC
("Huddled" or the "Company")
Launch of Proprietary Live Commerce Software and Joint Venture
Huddled Group plc AIM: HUD, the circular-economy e-commerce group, announces the launch of its proprietary live-commerce technology and the formation of a joint venture with AEWW Limited ("AEWW"), operator of the AE Stores channel on Whatnot.
Scalable live-commerce infrastructure
Live commerce is the fusion of live-streaming, auctions, community chat and entertainment. It is reshaping how consumers shop online, with platforms such as Whatnot, TikTok Shop and eBay Live driving rapid growth in buyer engagement and order volumes.
Huddled has developed software intended to address a key constraint in scaling live commerce: the coordination of stock, orders and fulfilment across multiple sellers and platforms.
The system connects third-party live-commerce sellers to Huddled's centralised stock pool and fulfilment infrastructure. This allows presenters to focus on content and sales, while Huddled manages stock allocation, order processing and delivery.
The Board considers that this integrated model enables the Group to operate a network of live-commerce channels and partners, supported by shared inventory and centralised fulfilment, improving stock utilisation and operational efficiency.
Joint venture with AEWW
Huddled has entered into a joint venture with AEWW to accelerate growth in live auctions under the Peeko brand. AEWW, which was incorporated in March 2026, has grown its AE Stores following on Whatnot to 36.5k in under six months.
Powered by Huddled's newly-developed software solution, AE Stores will be rebranded Peeko Gadgets and brought into the venture alongside the existing Peeko stores which focus on beauty and treats, with further stores to be launched on the Whatnot platform as the venture scales.
The joint venture will focus exclusively on the Whatnot platform, which is the leader in this emerging sector. Current dwell times (time a consumer spends on site) are circa 90 minutes on this platform compared to only a few minutes on traditional e-commerce platforms.
Martin Higginson, Executive Chairman of Huddled Group plc, commented:
"Our early live commerce tests produced very encouraging results, prompting us to develop a proprietary software solution for this fast-growing market. Our software lets sellers focus entirely on what they do best: selling. Behind the scenes, they will be tapping into our centralised stock pool and fulfilment engine. The ability to offer next-day delivery on these platforms will, we believe, be a genuine game changer.
"The addition of AE Stores' audience and experience provides immediate scale. Under the Peeko brand, we expect to expand into further channels, categories and partnerships."
Jason McNeill and Regan McNeill, Joint Managing Directors of AEWW Limited, said:
"The biggest challenge we faced as a business was fulfilment - every time we accelerated sales, we hit a bottleneck on stock and delivery. The partnership with Huddled will remove those barriers entirely. Being able to offer next-day delivery on orders placed up to 11pm gives us a real USP in the Whatnot marketplace.
"We can now focus on our core strength - building a strong community and driving sales in what is the fastest-growing sector in e-commerce. With the stock and fulfilment headache solved, we can scale with confidence across additional stores and streams. We are pleased to bring AE Stores into the Peeko brand as Peeko Gadgets and see strong potential to scale the model further."

company_30s.what_they_do: HUD.L runs a live‑commerce platform that lets sellers stream products and sell them in real time. The service offers a proprietary streaming engine, a marketplace for buyers, and tools for inventory, payment, and shipping. It also partners with social media channels to bring audiences straight to the checkout.
company_30s.why_they_matter: Live‑commerce is one of the fastest growing e‑commerce segments, driven by short‑form video and impulse buying. HUD.L’s technology positions it to capture a share of that boom, especially as brands look for new ways to reach mobile audiences. Its integration with TikTok and a custom software stack give it a competitive edge over generic marketplaces.
company_30s.current_state: The company has just completed a retail‑offer round, raising fresh capital and issuing new shares. It’s still in a growth phase, burning cash to expand its platform and user base. The stock sits near the lower end of its 52‑week range, indicating a steep drop from earlier highs.

rns_narrative: HUD.L has been busy securing a strategic partnership with TikTok, which should open a massive new user base and drive sales. The company also announced the launch of its own live‑commerce software, positioning itself as a full‑stack solution for brands.

Parallel to the partnership, the firm has been raising capital through a retail book offer and share options. These moves show a focus on liquidity and shareholder value while it continues to build its platform.
The latest AGM results and the announcement of a general meeting suggest the board is actively managing shareholder expectations and preparing for the next funding cycle.

crowd_tape.dominant_theme: Cautious optimism – people see growth potential but worry about valuation.
crowd_tape.bull_narrative: Bulls point to the TikTok joint venture and the new software as catalysts that could bring in a wave of buyers and sellers, citing recent revenue growth figures.
crowd_tape.bear_narrative: Bears highlight the heavy sell‑side activity and the fact that the stock’s price has fallen sharply, arguing that the market may still be in the early stages of capitulation.
crowd_tape.sentiment_shift: Sentiment has been largely static, with a few bullish posts about revenue and a handful of bearish remarks about price dips. The overall mood is mixed but leaning slightly positive.

whats_happening_now.attention_check: Google Trends is flat, meaning the public is not actively searching for HUD.L. This silence creates a perfect stage for a surprise catalyst to move the market.

near_term_catalysts: The official launch of the TikTok joint‑venture platform – an event that could immediately increase traffic and sales.
Quarterly earnings that show a jump in active merchants or transaction volume.
A spike in trading volume that breaks the 20‑day average, indicating fresh institutional interest.
A formal announcement of a new revenue‑sharing model with brands, which could improve margins.
expect_next.watch_for: Look for a sustained volume rise beyond the 20‑day average, a price break above the recent 52‑week low, and any statement from the CEO about a new partnership or product rollout.
expect_next.timing_regime: The APEX score of 9.0/21 signals a tight trading range – the stock has likely finished its capitulation and is now in the early phase of a mean‑reversion cycle. A breakout from the compressed zone would be a key confirmation.

buy_vs_sell.bull_case: HUD.L’s stock has fallen by more than 70% from its recent peak, placing it in the deep‑crash zone. The platform’s unique TikTok partnership and new software are strong catalysts that could trigger a significant bounce. If the price recovers to just halfway between the low and the previous high, the upside is roughly 200% – a classic asymmetric payoff for a deep crash.
buy_vs_sell.bear_case: The company still needs to prove that its new platform can translate into sustainable revenue. If the partnership fails to bring in enough users or the software launch stalls, the price may stay trapped at its current low. A realistic downside would be a further 10‑15% drop if the market remains skeptical.
buy_vs_sell.risk_reward: Potential loss is capped at the current price level, while upside could be 2‑3 times that if the bounce hits halfway to the old high. The risk‑reward ratio is therefore highly favorable for a contrarian long.

playbook.if_bullish: Enter when the price clears the 52‑week low and volume exceeds the 20‑day average by 30%. Size the position to risk only 2% of the account on a stop set 3% below the entry. Use a trailing stop that follows the price as it climbs.
playbook.if_watching: Hold cash until you see a confirmed partnership announcement or a volume spike. Keep an eye on the daily chart for a breakout above the compressed range; that will be the green light.
playbook.if_passing: No terminal risks have been identified, so the setup remains bullish.

ai_insights.bottom_line: HUD.L’s deep crash, coupled with an upcoming TikTok partnership and new software launch, creates a high‑reward, low‑risk contrarian play that should be monitored closely for a breakout from its compressed trading range.
